SELECT DISTINCT PTL.CDATE CDATE, PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL.ACCT_ID ACCTID, PTL.CCY CCY, PTL.HODING_TYPE HODINGTYPE, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME PORTFOLIONAME, STL.ACCT_NAME ACCTNAME, PTL.AMOUNT, FLOW.AMOUNT1 FROM PTL_CASH_POSITION PTL LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PTLACCT ON PTLACCT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PTLACCT.ACCT_NO = PTL.ACCT_ID INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO STL ON STL.ACCT_NO = PTL.ACCT_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL.ACCT_ID, PTL.CDATE, PTL.CCY, PTL.HODING_TYPE, SUM(PTL.AMOUNT) AMOUNT1 FROM PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW PTL LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PTLACCT ON PTLACCT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PTLACCT.ACCT_NO = PTL.ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FP.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID
GROUP BY PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL.ACCT_ID, PTL.CDATE, PTL.CCY, PTL.HODING_TYPE ) FLOW ON PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = FLOW.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PTL.ACCT_ID = FLOW.ACCT_ID AND PTL.CDATE = FLOW.CDATE AND PTL.CCY = FLOW.CCY AND PTL.HODING_TYPE = FLOW.HODING_TYPE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FP.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID
order by PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID,PTL.CDATE asc

SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, F.PORTFOLIO_NAME text, A.PORTFOLIO_ID hidCode FROM PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW A inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO F on A.PORTFOLIO_ID = F.PORTFOLIO_ID
(A.PORTFOLIO_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or F.PORTFOLIO_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))
